subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only
stimulus: the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1×8= 8 (a) The function began at 10 am. (b). The Headmaster called the recipients by name. (c) It was held in the school campus. (d) The main ceremony began then. (e) We decorated the school building very tastefully. (f) The prize giving ceremony of our school was held on 2 April 2000. (g) began with the recitation from the holy Quran. (h) The Headmaster read out his report.
guide_solution: The parts of the story can appear in the following order: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 f c e a g h d b
